author: KEXP
description: On the latest release from Melody's Echo Chamber, the French star celebrates the present moment with shimmering psychedelic pop. Live on KEXP with host Troy Nelson, she shares a performance of "In The Stars" and more from 'Unclouded.'
title: Melody's Echo Chamber performs "In The Stars" & more Live on KEXP
